summary_markdown:
The group discussed the updated automated deployment process for the `ml-api` to the analytics environment. [p1] confirmed that auto-deployment is now active, requiring only a commit to the main branch (including merge commits from pull requests) to trigger the deployment.

[p1] provided instructions on how to verify the deployed version by checking the API endpoint for date, time (UTC), branch, and commit hash.
decisions: The `ml-api` is now set up for automated deployment upon committing to the main branch.
